'''Grand Admiral Tsung The Fleet has Arrived v.1''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Grand Admiral Tsung]]
* '''Published:''' 5 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' The Fleet has Arrived v.1
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 The Fleet has Arrived v.1 Tsung LS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Naboo meets The Rebel Fleet for some butt kicking time.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

As usual Supreme force is my main strategy.  Use Legendary starfighter so that the enemy is losing force no matter what. Use both Get to your ships and Squadron assignments to pull ships and pilots quickly.  The Bravo Pilots protect against droid fighters while the other pilots provide a swarm of destructive fury. Capitol ships will be used for backup. The A-wing keeps out any of the opponents unwanted backup during a battle. Use the pilots without unique starfighters on the Capitol ships to make them powerhouses.

The motives of this deck are cause drains, distraction, and above all cause Destruction.

Hmm... the motives seem kinda nasty to be a of the lightside.
